events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis - Iran Closure Disrupting Global Oil Supply
events.summary: Iran IRGC closed Strait of Hormuz in retaliation for US/Israeli strikes. 20M barrels/day of oil traffic disrupted. Biggest global energy disruption in decades. Brent at $93+, EIA forecasts $87 avg for 2026. Saudi Arabia rerouting oil around Africa.

events.title: Historic US-Japan Joint Currency Intervention - Yen Rescue Unravelling
events.summary: US Treasury and Japan jointly intervened to support yen (first in 15 years). US sold euros (not dollars) to buy yen, blindsiding ECB. Japan spent est. $36-59B. Yen has already erased half the gains, back to 159. BOJ hinting at September rate hike. 30Y Treasury yield at 5.2% - highest since 2007.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - Fastest Growing Outbreak on Record, WHO PHEIC Declared
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC/Uganda. 4,566 confirmed cases, 2,128 deaths as of Aug 11. Declared WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Fastest growing Ebola outbreak on record. Existing treatments certified for Zaire species, not Bundibugyo. Deaths doubled in last 20 days.

events.title: 2026 Iran War - Active Conflict with US/Israel, Hormuz Closure
events.summary: Active war between Iran and US/Israel. Iran launched retaliatory missile/drone strikes on US embassies, military installations, and oil infrastructure. IRGC closed Strait of Hormuz. US conducting strikes on Iran. Trump claims control of Hormuz, Iran denies. Ceasefire talks ongoing but fragile.

events.title: Gaza War Escalation - Netanyahu Refuses Withdrawal, Ceasefire Destabilized
events.summary: Israeli airstrikes on Gaza resumed (Aug 13). Netanyahu says forces will not withdraw until Hamas genuinely disarmed. 70,000+ Gazans killed. Trump Board of Peace reached disarmament agreement July 31 but implementation stalled. Ceasefire destabilized by Israeli attacks on Hamas officials.

events.title: UK Faces Worst Food Security Crisis in Decades - Drought
events.summary: Three quarters of England in drought. Soils parched, crop failures. Market analysts warn most severe food security crisis in decades. Afghanistan hunger crisis affects 14M people. Nigeria food insecurity deteriorating due to Middle East conflict and climate shocks.

events.title: China Property Crisis - $148B Expiring Leases Time Bomb, $130B Defaults
events.summary: China racing to solve $148B property threat as land leases expire. Office values down 40%+ from peaks. Developers defaulted on roughly $130B of debt. PBOC pledging appropriately loose monetary stance. Overnight reverse repo operations scheduled.

events.title: Private Credit Distress - Growing PIK Payments, Borrower Strain
events.summary: Fed Boston research shows growing share of private credit borrowers making payments-in-kind (PIK) instead of cash. Fitch default rate includes bankruptcies and deferred interest. Highly-indebted companies ditching private credit for cheaper bank loans. Not imminent crisis but deteriorating.
